properties.description:
We are a fast growing, value-added distributor of consumer products. We offer focus, speed, agility and a high level of communication.

Our team is made up of a number of highly experienced and well respected personnel with a background working in distribution and major retail.

We work with a number of well known and emerging brands across several industry sectors, supporting national retailers including Argos/Sainsburys, John Lewis, Very, Currys, Costco & more.

We provide dropship fulfilment to a number of retailers as well as servicing online sales channels such as Amazon and eBay with an expert in-house team.

If you're a retailer or brand interested in discussing a potential partnership, please contact us on 0800 669 6397 or email hello@go10.co.uk
